## Starter Suite FAQs 

### What is Starter Suite? 

Starter Suite is a turnkey CRM from Salesforce that brings sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Slack together on one connected platform, built for small teams that want to get started quickly. Every team works from the same view of the customer, so sales, service, and marketing stay in sync. Starter Suite also includes Agentforce Coworker, an AI teammate that answers questions from your Salesforce data, updates records after you confirm, and sends personalized emails through simple chat, with no upgrade required. Setup is guided, so teams can get started quickly. When your needs grow, you can upgrade to Pro Suite for advanced customization and automation.

Watch the demo video to see Starter Suite in action.

### How do I get started with Starter? 

Getting started is completely turnkey. Simply sign up for a free 30-day trial to begin exploring the platform immediately. To help you hit the ground running, take advantage of these built-in resources: - Guided Checklist: Follow step-by-step guidance to set up your CRM in minutes. - Interactive Demos: Click through and see Starter Suite's tools in action before you build. - Live Workshops: Learn best practices directly from our experts in guided, interactive sessions. When you're ready, you can easily purchase Starter Suite through our simple self-checkout.

### What can the built-in AI actually do for my business? 

Agentforce Coworker acts as a built-in team member that reads, summarizes, and updates customer details, letting you spend less time on admin and more time selling. Starter Suite also includes AI that analyzes your video calls to automatically generate transcripts and meeting summaries. For example, a lean, ambitious sales team can use this to quickly prep for meetings.

### Do the AI features require technical setup? 

There is zero setup required. Salesforce builds AI directly into the workflows lean teams already use. You don't need an IT department or complex integrations to get started. For example, your team can log in on day one and immediately ask the built-in assistant to draft customer responses based on past case history.

### How does Starter Suite support my business goals? 

As you turn new leads into lifelong customers, Starter provides the reliable foundation your team needs. Run your sales, marketing, and service right out of the box—all seamlessly connected through Slack, where your team already works. And when your ambition demands even deeper customization and complex automation, moving to Pro Suite is completely seamless. Compare Starter and Pro to see which matches your ambition.

### How much does Starter cost? 

Starter is available starting at $25 USD per user, per month, which can be billed monthly or annually. Check out this data sheet to learn more about the features included in Starter. Starter includes 2,000 emails per month. Plus, you can add on more as needed with the Marketing Email Sends Bundle for an additional 1,000 email sends for $10 USD per month. Commerce functionality in Starter are subject to transaction fees. Pricing is pay-as-you-go and rates vary by region and payment method. For example, credit card payments in the U.S. are 2.9% + $0.30 USD per transaction.

### What is the difference between Pro Suite and Starter Suite? 

Pro Suite includes all the capabilities and built-in AI found in Starter Suite, but adds deep, advanced customization. Teams can build custom apps, create custom objects, and access prebuilt solutions on the AgentExchange. It also provides a sandbox environment for safe testing and training. Lean teams upgrade to Pro Suite when they need complex workflow automation to match a highly specific sales cycle.

### When should a business upgrade from Starter Suite to Pro Suite? 

Teams move to Pro Suite when their workflows demand deeper customization, complex automation, or external app integrations. It builds on Starter’s turnkey AI by unlocking custom objects, a testing sandbox, and advanced tools like sales forecasting—giving you the exact firepower needed to map complex sales cycles and accurately track revenue.
